lines.en: I stride on two long legs.
Each step covers a lot of ground.
My neck stretches and retracts.

lines.zh: 草原上的草到我胸口高。
lines.en: The savanna grass reaches my chest.

lines.zh: 我踩着干土，扬起一点尘。
lines.en: My feet raise a little dust from the dry soil.

lines.zh: 我的影子长长的，在前面。
lines.en: My long shadow goes ahead of me.
My head stays level as I walk.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，扫着地平线。
lines.en: Step, pause, sweep the horizon.

lines.zh: 我踩着路上骨头的碎片。
lines.en: I tread over splinters of bone.
In strong wind I walk at an angle.
I head for that stand of low trees.
My toes spread as I plant my foot.
I cut straight across the open ground.
I keep to the forest edge.
My stride steadies as I go.

lines.zh: 我在矮草和灌丛间穿行。
lines.en: I thread between low grass and scrub.
I stand and turn my neck about.
There's a little dried blood on my beak.
I tighten my feathers and hold still.
The wind lifts the feathers at my collar.
I peck once at the ground.
The muscles on my thigh stand out.
I squint against the sun.
I've stood here a long while.

lines.zh: 我没有翅膀能飞，只有腿。
lines.en: I have no wings to fly, only legs.
I flex my toes.
I'm waiting for something to pass.
You stand a little above the grass.
I'm taller than you, but you aren't large.

lines.zh: 你腿上没有毛，看着很脆。
lines.en: Your legs have no feathers; they look brittle.

lines.zh: 你在跑之前最好想清楚。
lines.en: Think it over before you run.
My beak can crack bone.
There's wind right where you stand.
When I run, the savanna falls back.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在草原上传得远。
lines.en: Your steps carry far on the savanna.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被人从侧面盯着。
lines.en: I don't like being watched from the side.
One step and I am there, my legs are long.
I sway, but my legs hold.

lines.zh: 草原上的巨鸟，跑得比马快。
lines.en: A savanna giant bird outruns a horse.
That landed on my breastbone.
I turn to guard my neck.
This won't slow my running.
Blood drips onto dry grass.
I'll charge again.
Under these feathers is bone, not soft meat.
Meat? Put it down.

lines.zh: 你举着它，是在喂我还是激我。
lines.en: Holding it out — feeding me or daring me?
That piece is too small.
I want the whole one.
Throw the food farther off.
I strike fast at food.
That's not even one bite.
I don't take from a hand.
Let go first, then bring it.
That's not the smell I'm after.
You hit my leg; it did nothing.
You stepped on my toes.

lines.zh: 我抬腿从你头顶跨过去。
lines.en: I lift a leg and stride over you.
Neither of us would give way.
My wings fold close; I'm narrow.
I knock you back three steps.
You're too close; I don't like it.
Out of the way. I can't brake.

lines.zh: 草原上还有另一个影子。
lines.en: There's another shadow on the savanna.
It stands half a head taller.
We walked together for a stretch.
It dipped to feed first.
We kept our distance.
It called, low.
We circled the same scrub.
There's an old wound on its leg.
We parted again.
This land only feeds one hunter.
I carry this bone in my beak.
Too hard; I hammer it twice.
I carry the meat off at a run so none can steal it.
Meat on the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 这东西发苦，我甩头吐掉。
lines.en: This one tastes bitter; I shake my head and spit it out.
That's not enough.
I hide it in the grass.
I pin it with a foot, then tear.
It's gone bad already.
You've noticed me watching.
I've taken the first step.
My head has come down.

lines.zh: 草原上的大鸟，跑得比你还快。
lines.en: A savanna bird faster than you.
I've read your route.
The wind blows from behind me.
I don't call out, and I don't wait.
My toes dig into the soil.
The moment you turn, I move.
This isn't complicated.
The more you back away, the closer I get.
I fix on your neck.
I follow without losing a step.

lines.zh: 我在草原上跑得比你快。
lines.en: I run faster than you on this savanna.
You go around the tree; so do I.
My long legs don't mind ditches.

lines.zh: 你跑向林子，那不是好主意。
lines.en: Running for the trees isn't a good idea.
I stay off your flank.
Your breathing has gone ragged.

lines.zh: 我等的是你慢下来的那一刻。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to slow.
I stride over a stone.

lines.zh: 这里的草太短，藏不住你。
lines.en: The grass is too short to hide you.
Distance won't help.
I hear your feet slipping.
My kick lands on your waist.
My beak snaps shut.
You're knocked sprawling.
I lift a foot and stomp again.
You back off; one stride and I'm there.
My claws score into your armor.
That hit harder than it looked.

lines.zh: 我的爪子扣住你的小腿，往下拖。
lines.en: My talons hook your calf and drag you down.
I had no intention of easing off.
You've got a few new gashes.
I rise from behind the dry grass.

lines.zh: 我在草原上现身，影子先到。
lines.en: Here I appear — my shadow first.
I shake the feathers on my neck.
This isn't my first time here.
I stomp the ground solid.
The sun's going west. Just right.
First I read the terrain.

lines.zh: 我的腿很冷，可走起来就热。
lines.en: My legs are cold, but walking warms them.
No other scent on the wind.
I wipe my beak on the dirt.
This stretch of savanna is mine to use.
I lift a foot and test it.
My landing is a dull thud.
On the savanna, I stretch my long legs.

lines.zh: 草烧着了，我从火边跳开。
lines.en: The grass is burning; I spring clear.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下，腿磕了一下。
lines.en: I slide down a slope and jar my leg.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我蹬着往上。
lines.en: Water floods my throat; I kick for the top.
The blast throws me sideways.

lines.zh: 光缠住我的腿，我站不稳。
lines.en: Light binds my legs and I stagger.
Empty-bellied, I can't run.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，羽毛全黑了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my feathers blacken.

lines.zh: 这里没有地面给我的长腿。
lines.en: No ground here for these long legs.
